Attempt.description: One scheduling of a workplan into a run; a resumed run has several.

system.description: The C-Star system the attempt was scheduled on.
system.title: System

versions.description: The versions of the packages the attempt was scheduled with.
versions.title: Versions

workplan_content_hash.description: A fingerprint of the workplan as this attempt ran it.
workplan_content_hash.title: Workplan Content Hash

clobbered.description: The steps the attempt cleared and re-ran.
clobbered.title: Clobbered

resumed.description: The steps the attempt resumed in place.
resumed.title: Resumed

pre_run.description: Whether the attempt stopped every step before its model launch.
pre_run.title: Pre Run

finished_at.description: Set once every step reached a terminal status: the completion marker.
finished_at.title: Finished At

directory.title: Directory

carried.description:
The digest of each file the attempt carried, as `sha256:<hex>`, by its path
relative to `directory`.
carried.title: Carried

Attempt.title: Attempt

AttemptStatus.description: Where an attempt to run a workplan stands.
AttemptStatus.title: AttemptStatus

BlueprintIdentity.description:
Identifies a blueprint document by application, name and content hash.

This is identity, not location: compare `DeferredBlueprintRef`, which
locates the blueprint file an upstream step will write.

kind.description: The kind of document referenced; selects the model a reference loads as.
kind.title: Kind

application.description: The application the referenced blueprint belongs to.
application.title: Application

name.description: The name of the referenced blueprint.
name.title: Name

content_hash.description: A fingerprint of the referenced blueprint's configuration.
content_hash.title: Content Hash

BlueprintIdentity.title: BlueprintIdentity

CatalogSpecRef.description: A reference to a catalog spec a document was derived from.

name.description: The name of the referenced spec.
name.title: Name

origin.description: Where the spec came from, e.g. `catalog`, `custom` or `model_default`; empty when unknown.
origin.title: Origin

modified.description: Whether the spec was edited after it was selected.
modified.title: Modified

CatalogSpecRef.title: CatalogSpecRef

CodebaseRef.description: An external codebase a blueprint builds.
CodebaseRef.title: CodebaseRef

ExecutionFacts.description:
What ran a step: the scheduler and the allocation it was granted, read from
the step's own environment.

These are the granted resources, never the request: the request is in the
transformed workplan and the batch script. They describe the step's own
process; a model run the step submits as a job of its own is not described.

scheduler.description:
`slurm` when the step ran inside a SLURM job, else `local`; empty in a
record written before schema 1.2.0.
scheduler.title: Scheduler

job_id.description: The id of the SLURM job the step ran in; empty outside SLURM.
job_id.title: Job Id

host.description: The host the step process ran on; under SLURM, the batch node.
host.title: Host

pid.description: The id of the step process.
pid.title: Pid

nodes.description: The nodes granted to the job; zero outside SLURM or when not reported.
nodes.title: Nodes

tasks.description: The tasks granted to the job; zero outside SLURM or when not reported.
tasks.title: Tasks

cpus.description:
The CPUs granted per node, on the node the step process ran on; zero outside
SLURM or when not reported.
cpus.title: Cpus

partition.description: The partition the job ran in; empty outside SLURM or when not reported.
partition.title: Partition

account.description: The account the job was charged to; empty outside SLURM or when not reported.
account.title: Account

ExecutionFacts.title: ExecutionFacts

ExternalDependencies.description: Everything a run depends on that lives outside the run itself.

catalog_entries.description: Catalog specs the blueprints were derived from.
catalog_entries.title: Catalog Entries

blueprints.description: Blueprints the blueprints were derived from.
blueprints.title: Blueprints

ExternalDependencies.title: ExternalDependencies

ExternalRun.description: Another workplan run this run reads from.

alias.description: The alias the workplan refers to the run by.
alias.title: Alias

run_id.description:
The id of the run: the referenced run's once it was resolved, otherwise
the reference as authored.
run_id.title: Run Id

id.description:
The uuid of the run as resolved when the workplan was scheduled; empty when
it was not resolved.
id.title: Id

start_at.description: The restart time the run was referenced at, when pinned.
start_at.title: Start At

ExternalRun.title: ExternalRun

Product.description: A file or directory a step produced.

kind.description:
The classification of the product: one of `ArtifactKind` when written by
this release. Kept as text on disk so a record written with a kind this
build no longer knows still loads; `known_kind` maps it for consumers.
kind.title: Kind

path.description: The location of the product, relative to the step root.
path.title: Path

size_bytes.description: The size of the product in bytes; zero when not measured.
size_bytes.title: Size Bytes

sha256.description:
A bare sha256 of the product's bytes, written by no current release: kept so
records that predate `digest` load, and folded into `digest` on load.
sha256.title: Sha256

digest.description:
The content digest of the product, `<scheme>:<hex>`: `nc-sample-v2` for a
netCDF file (structure plus a bounded sample of its data, independent of the
on-disk encoding), `sha256` of the bytes otherwise. Empty when not computed;
`cstar run check --record-digests` records it.
digest.title: Digest

metadata.description: Model-specific detail, such as an output stream.
metadata.title: Metadata

Product.title: Product

name.description: The dataset's name, when it has one.
name.title: Name

hash.description: The content hash of the data, when recorded.
hash.title: Hash

StepEntry.description: A step of the run, as the manifest knows it.

working_dir.description: The step's working directory relative to the run root; `.` for a standalone run.
working_dir.title: Working Dir

definition_hash.description: A fingerprint of what the step computes (see `describe_steps`).
definition_hash.title: Definition Hash

blueprint.description: The blueprint the step runs; `None` until a deferred step's record names it.

carried_blueprint.description:
The copy of the step's blueprint file the latest attempt with a directory
carried, relative to the run root; empty when that attempt carried none for
the step. Not the file the step ran: that is its record's `blueprint_file`.
carried_blueprint.title: Carried Blueprint

launcher.description:
The launcher that last submitted the step (`slurm` or `local`), which says
what `job_id` is; empty when never submitted by an orchestrator.
launcher.title: Launcher

job_id.description:
The id of the step's latest submission: a SLURM job id under `slurm`, the
process id of the step's launch script under `local`; empty when never
submitted.
job_id.title: Job Id

submitted_at.description: When the latest submission was made; `None` when never submitted.
submitted_at.title: Submitted At

status.description: The orchestration status name as of `observed_at`; empty when never observed.
status.title: Status

record.description: The step's record, folded in once the step has written it.

StepEntry.title: StepEntry

StepRecord.description: What a step did: written by the step process, in its working directory.

schema_version.description: The schema version for the document.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

run_id.description: The run the step belongs to; empty for a standalone `cstar blueprint run`.
run_id.title: Run Id

blueprint_schema_version.description: The schema version of the blueprint the step ran.
blueprint_schema_version.title: Blueprint Schema Version

blueprint_file.description:
The blueprint file the step ran, such as `work/<stem>.ovrd.yaml`, relative to
the step root; empty when it lies outside the step root.
blueprint_file.title: Blueprint File

outcome.description: The runner's execution status as its lowercase name, e.g. `completed`.
outcome.title: Outcome

start_at.description: When the step process started; `None` when it never started.
start_at.title: Start At

finished_at.description: When the step process recorded its outcome.
finished_at.title: Finished At

system.description: The C-Star system the step ran on.
system.title: System

versions.description: The versions of the packages the step ran with.
versions.title: Versions

StepRecord.title: StepRecord

WorkplanIdentity.description: Identifies the workplan a run was scheduled from.

content_hash.description: A fingerprint of the workplan as authored.
content_hash.title: Content Hash

path.description: The workplan file, as given on the command line.
path.title: Path

WorkplanIdentity.title: WorkplanIdentity

description: The description of a run: written to its run root.

schema_version.description: The schema version for the document.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

id.description: A unique identifier minted when the manifest is first written.
id.title: Id

run_id.description: The run's id: the name of its directory.
run_id.title: Run Id

name.description: The name of the workplan or blueprint the run was made from.
name.title: Name

kind.description: Whether the run is a workplan or a standalone blueprint.
kind.title: Kind

system.description: The C-Star system the run was first scheduled on.
system.title: System

created_at.description: When the manifest was first written.
created_at.title: Created At

workplan.description: The workplan the run was scheduled from; `None` for a standalone blueprint.

attempts.description: Every scheduling of the run, oldest first.
attempts.title: Attempts

external.description: What the run depends on outside itself.

observed_at.description: When the statuses and records were last folded in.
observed_at.title: Observed At

title: RunManifest
